_note: PLACEHOLDER learning content for the prototype. Not research data. '{skill}' is replaced with the skill name. Add skill-specific content under 'skills' keyed by skill slug (e.g. 'data_analysis'); each list must have 6 entries.

default.title: Get oriented: what is {skill}?
default.description: A short overview of what {skill} means at work and where it is used. You will see one simple example of it in practice.

default.title: Key terms in {skill}
default.description: Learn the handful of words people use when they talk about {skill}. Knowing them makes later steps easier to follow.

default.title: A first small task
default.description: Try a guided, low-stakes task that uses {skill}. Follow the steps and compare your result with the worked example.

default.title: Practise with a real-world case
default.description: Apply {skill} to a short workplace scenario. The case is a little more open, so you make a few decisions yourself.

default.title: Spot and fix common mistakes
default.description: Review typical errors people make with {skill} and practise correcting them. This builds accuracy and confidence.

default.title: Show what you can do
default.description: Complete a short task you could describe in a CV or interview. It brings together everything from this pathway.
